messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager: High error rate for customer Goldcrest on dedicated pool gdc-pool-7. AlertID=INC-2026-03-GC-71

alex: I'm on it, taking pager. Can someone drop the current metrics?

maria: grabbing logs from gdc-pool-7 runners now. Seeing a spike of 502/504s and repeated kv-cache-miss logs.

samir: FYI we just rolled canary artifact art:goldcrest:v2026-03-13-3 to that pool ~20m ago. Could be related.

lina: pinging Goldcrest SRE (todd) — letting them know we're investigating impact.

ops-bot: Customer impact: requests failing for tenant goldcrest-corp across region eu-west-1, ~40% traffic errors, increased tail latency. Notified support channel.

alex: @todd (Goldcrest SRE) can you confirm any config changes on your side?

try todd (Goldcrest SRE): We're not doing anything on our side. Seeing timeout spikes in our app logs when calling /redwood/generate. Losing KV cache entries per-run?

maria: paste of recent runner logs (sanitized):
```
[2026-03-13T14:02:12Z] runner-17 | model init ok
[2026-03-13T14:03:03Z] runner-17 | kv-cache: prefix_mismatch detected for tenant goldcrest-corp, clearing
[2026-03-13T14:03:03Z] runner-17 | generate request id=abc123 latency=1200ms error=timeout
[2026-03-13T14:03:25Z] runner-18 | OOM warning: approx mem=14.8GB, threshold=15GB
[2026-03-13T14:04:01Z] runner-18 | 502 upstream model runner failed
```

alex: KV prefix mismatch + mem pressure. Could be artifact change that altered tokenization or cache keys. Samir, does v2026-03-13-3 include any tokenizer or KV layout changes?

samir: It includes an optimization to shard the KV by shard-id and a small tokenizer patch (bytepair tweaks) to save memory. We attempted backward compatibility but maybe not for pinned artifact scenarios.

lina: Goldcrest is seeing production traffic but they've got strict SLAs. Todd requests immediate traffic isolation / minimize blast radius.

alex: Plan: 1) Divert Goldcrest traffic off gdc-pool-7 to standby dedicated nodes (gdc-pool-5), 2) Pin Goldcrest to previous artifact art:goldcrest:v2026-03-10-9, 3) If necessary, scale up warm nodes. Anyone object?

maria: agree. Diverting now will avoid broad tenant quarantine. I'll run the divert.

samir: I'll prepare the pinback and artifact rollout. Which rollout id do you want? Previous stable rollout r-20260310-9.

alex: Use r-20260310-9. Lina, coordinate with Todd for brief expected downtime ~1-3m during switchover.

lina: on it. Todd confirms okay, they prefer we cut traffic immediately.

maria: executing traffic divert command:
```
# divert Goldcrest to gdc-pool-5
redwoodctl traffic divert --tenant goldcrest-corp --from-pool gdc-pool-7 --to-pool gdc-pool-5 --dry-run=false
```

ops-bot: Command accepted, divert request queued -> job-id=job-66812. Estimated completion 90s.

alex: while that's running, Samir, start pinback: lock artifact for tenant and trigger rollout to pinned version.

samir: running pin command now:
```
# pin tenant to previous artifact
redwoodctl tenant pin --tenant goldcrest-corp --artifact art:goldcrest:v2026-03-10-9 --rollback-policy immediate
```

ops-bot: Pin job started job-id=job-66813. Canaries disabled for this tenant, override=true.

maria: divert job shows success. Traffic stats: errors dropped from 42% -> 4% over 2 minutes. Tail latency improving.

alex: good. Keep monitoring for KV errors and OOMs. Maria, pull a heap profile from runner-18 and check whether patch caused higher peak allocation.

maria: pulled heap profile and diff vs baseline shows increased transient allocation ~18% at tokenization phase. That matches tokenizer tweak.

samir: ok summary: artifact v2026-03-13-3 introduced tokenizer change + KV sharding that is incompatible with live cached sessions for existing tenants. Rolling back for Goldcrest is correct. We'll halt further canary progress and run a gated audit.

lina: Todd: can you validate end-to-end with your app?

try todd (Goldcrest SRE): running smoke now... generation requests succeeding, error rate back to normal. Thanks. We'll keep a watch for 30m.

alex: On-call handoff note for next shift: issue caused by non-backwards-compatible tokenizer change in canary artifact. Recommend: (a) Temporary freeze of canary for shared dedicated pools, (b) require tokenizer compatibility test in model onboarding for pinned-tenants scenario, (c) add a KV-prefix-compatibility check in preflight.

maria: filed ticket INF-2026-203 for KV-prefix compatibility tests + profiler benchmark.

samir: filing a rollback postmortem and gating checklist PR for artifact builder: PR-arch-992.

ops-bot: Incident update: Goldcrest traffic restored to stable. Post-incident action items: INF-2026-203, PR-arch-992, schedule canary freeze until compatibility tests added.

alex: closing pager for now. If any regression, page again. Great cross-team work, thanks everyone. :thumbsup:

lina: I'll follow up with Goldcrest support summary and timeline.

todd (Goldcrest SRE): Appreciate the quick help. Please include the exact window and artifact ids in the incident summary.

alex: noted. Summary to be posted to incident tracker within 2 hours.

ops-bot: Incident closed by alex at 2026-03-13T14:53:21Z (thread end).
